content.user_title: Build Pinia Stores for Vue Apps
content.value_statement: Vue teams need clear Pinia patterns for stores, SSR, plugins, testing, and Nuxt. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused guidance from Pinia documentation.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to define Pinia stores with state, getters, actions, and setup-store patterns.
Guides store composition, shared getters, shared actions, and circular dependency avoidance.
Covers Pinia plugins for custom properties, added state, action wrappers, and Nuxt integration.
Provides testing guidance with @pinia/testing, mocked stores, stubbed actions, and plugin setup.
Describes SSR, hydration, Nuxt auto-imports, and HMR practices for Vue applications.
limitations: It is documentation guidance, not a runnable Pinia generator or validator.
It is based on Pinia v3.0.4 content generated on 2026-01-28.
It does not inspect your repository unless the host AI tool reads your project files.
It does not replace Vue, Nuxt, or TypeScript migration testing in your app.

use_cases.title: Create a New Store
use_cases.description: Design state, getters, and actions with Pinia patterns that fit a Vue feature.

use_cases.title: Prepare SSR and Nuxt Integration
use_cases.description: Apply Pinia guidance for request isolation, hydration, Nuxt plugins, and auto-imported stores.

use_cases.title: Improve Store Tests
use_cases.description: Use @pinia/testing patterns for unit tests, component tests, plugins, action stubs, and spies.

prompt_templates.title: Define a Basic Store
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Pinia skill to help me design a store for this Vue feature: [describe feature]. Include state, getters, actions, and naming guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Store Composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Pinia stores for composition problems and circular dependency risks. Suggest a safer structure using getters, computed values, or actions.

prompt_templates.title: Add Testing Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Pinia testing guidance to propose tests for this store and component. Include @pinia/testing setup, action stubbing, and plugin handling.

prompt_templates.title: Plan SSR and Nuxt Usage
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Pinia usage for Nuxt and SSR. Check request isolation, hydration order, plugin registration, store access outside components, and HMR support.

output_examples.input: I need a cart store for a Vue checkout flow.
output_examples.output: A structured recommendation with store name, state fields, derived getters, checkout actions, and notes about where to call related user stores.

output_examples.input: My Nuxt app uses Pinia in route middleware and plugins.
output_examples.output: A review checklist covering active Pinia instances, request-safe store creation, hydration timing, and Nuxt plugin registration.

output_examples.input: I want tests for a component that reads and updates a Pinia store.
output_examples.output: A test plan explaining createTestingPinia setup, when to stub actions, how to configure spies, and how to include Pinia plugins.

best_practices: Prefer setup stores when a feature needs composables, watchers, or complex TypeScript-friendly logic.
Use storeToRefs when destructuring state or getters so Vue reactivity is preserved.
Create a fresh Pinia instance for SSR requests and for isolated tests.
anti_patterns: Do not read another store state during setup when two stores depend on each other.
Do not call stores at module scope in SSR-sensitive code.
Do not destructure state directly from a store without preserving reactivity.
